ROW_TIP: Click: its page. Shift+click: its link in the chat. Right-click: more.
EMPTY_DUNGEONS: No dungeon quests in your log.
EMPTY_RAIDS: No raid quests in your log.
EMPTY_PVP: No PvP quests in your log.
NO_QUESTIE: QuestieDB isn't loaded: where to go is unknown.
LAYER_OBJECTIVES_TIP: Ordaen Quests: where the objectives of the quests you track are
LAYER_TURN_INS_TIP: Ordaen Quests: whom to turn in the completed quests you track to
SETTING_OWN_KEY: The quest log key opens Ordaen Quests
SETTING_OWN_KEY_TIP: Your Quest Log key (L) and its button in the menu open this window. Off: the game's quest log. While the log is docked on the map, both are the game's.
NOTHING_FOUND: No quest fits the search and the filter.
